critical_code_review_comments: Backend seed logic in /app/backend/server.py is idempotent via count check on db.events; verified=True and venue_name are persisted correctly on all 7 KA venues.
next_recurring_occurrence() correctly picks the next matching weekday+time within 15-day window; verified DECKZEHN and VENUS BAR fall on their spec'd weekdays.

Saves endpoints correctly return 401 without token; toggle_save is idempotent per (event_id, user_id).
register-push swallows relay errors and still returns 201 — matches spec 'may be placeholder — should not 500'.

rca_of_issue: save-event-button + recurring-badge: In /app/frontend/src/components/EventSheet.tsx the developer added the `saved` state, `loadSocial` fetch of save-status, `toggleSave` handler, and a `styles.saveHero` position style, but forgot to render the actual <Pressable testID="save-event-button"> in the hero JSX (lines 86-103). Similarly, event.is_recurring is used only in an inline meta row (line 108-111) instead of a dedicated badge component with testID="recurring-badge". Fix: add a bookmark Pressable overlay in the hero using styles.saveHero + Ionicons name={saved?'bookmark':'bookmark-outline'} onPress={toggleSave} testID="save-event-button"; and, when event.is_recurring, render a small pill (e.g. next to catBadge) with testID="recurring-badge" showing event.recurrence_label.
